en: I counted my money yesterday.

ar: ما حسبتش شحال ديال الكتب كاينين
en: I didn't count how many books there are.

ar: واش حسبتي الصرف مزيان ا خويا
en: Did you count the change well, my brother?
You didn't count the people in the classroom.

ar: واش حسبتي الورقات كاملين ا ختي
en: Did you count all the papers, my sister?
You didn't count the bread in the kitchen.
He counted the chairs in the room.
The shopkeeper didn't count the merchandise.
She counted the glasses before the party.
The girl didn't count her marks.
We counted the cash box at work today.
We didn't count how much we lost.
Did you count all the keys?
You didn't count the money well.
The teachers counted the children in the courtyard.

ar: هما ما حسبوش شحال بقى لينا
en: They didn't count how much is left for us.
Now I am counting the money at home.

lat: ana ma kan7sebch n-nuqat dyali daba
ar: انا ما كنحسبش النقط ديالي دابا
en: I am not counting my points now.
You count the change quickly.

lat: nta ma kat7sebch mzyan f l-lil
en: You don't count well at night.

lat: daba nti kat7esbi l-werqat f l-biru
en: Now you are counting the papers in the office.

lat: nti ma kat7esbich l-flus kul lila
ar: نتي ما كتحسبيش الفلوس كل ليلة
en: You don't count the money every night.
He counts the chairs in the cafe.

lat: huwa ma kay7sebch d-drari kul nhar
ar: هو ما كيحسبش الدراري كل نهار
en: He doesn't count the children every day.

lat: hiya kat7seb s-serf dyalha b chwiya
en: She counts her change slowly.
The girl does not count her money.
We are counting the glasses now in the kitchen.
We do not count the hours at work.

lat: wach ntuma kat7esbu s-serf kul merra
ar: واش نتوما كتحسبو الصرف كل مرة
en: Do you count the change every time?
You do not count your books.
They are counting the people at the party.

lat: huma ma kay7esbuch l-ayam dyal l-3utla
ar: هما ما كيحسبوش الايام ديال العطلة
en: They do not count vacation days.

lat: ghedda ana ghadi n7seb l-flus kamlin
ar: غدا انا غادي نحسب الفلوس كاملين
en: Tomorrow I am going to count all the money.

lat: ana ma ghadich n7seb s-serf daba
ar: انا ما غاديش نحسب الصرف دابا
en: I am not going to count the change now.

lat: wach nta ghadi t7seb l-werqat ghedda
ar: واش نتا غادي تحسب الورقات غدا
en: Are you going to count the papers tomorrow?

lat: nta ma ghadich t7seb l-ktub l-yum
ar: نتا ما غاديش تحسب الكتب اليوم
en: You are not going to count the books today.
You (f.) are going to count the money now.

lat: nti ma ghadich t7esbi l-krasi daba
ar: نتي ما غاديش تحسبي الكراسي دابا
en: You are not going to count the chairs now.

lat: huwa ghadi y7seb s-sel3a f l-7anut
en: He is going to count the goods in the shop.

lat: huwa ma ghadich y7seb l-flus dyalu
ar: هو ما غاديش يحسب الفلوس ديالو
en: He is not going to count his money.

lat: hiya ghadi t7seb l-werqat dyalha ghedda
ar: هي غادي تحسب الورقات ديالها غدا
en: She is going to count her papers tomorrow.

lat: khti ma ghadich t7seb n-nuqat dyalha
ar: ختي ما غاديش تحسب النقط ديالها
en: My sister is not going to count her marks.

ar: حنا غادي نحسبو شحال بقى لينا
en: We are going to count how much is left for us.

ar: حنا ما غاديش نحسبو كلشي اليوم
en: We are not going to count everything today.

lat: ntuma ghadi t7esbu l-kisan f l-kuzina
en: You are going to count the glasses in the kitchen.

lat: ntuma ma ghadich t7esbu l-flus ghedda
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تحسبو الفلوس غدا
en: You are not going to count the money tomorrow.

lat: huma ghadi y7esbu d-drari f t-tobis
en: They are going to count the children on the bus.

lat: huma ma ghadich y7esbu s-serf daba
ar: هما ما غاديش يحسبو الصرف دابا
en: They are not going to count the change now.
